subject: Invitation to join the Pilot program for GenAI features in SWAYAM-NPTEL courses
body:
Dear Niddana Apurva,

Greetings from the SWAYAM-NPTEL team! You are receiving this email as you have enrolled in one or more NPTEL courses in the current semester.

We’re excited to share that we will soon be rolling out a pilot program to introduce new GenAI-based features across select SWAYAM-NPTEL courses. This initiative is part of our efforts to enhance the learning experience using innovative tools and is completely FREE for all participating learners.

What’s the pilot about?

The Pilot will provide early access to GenAI-powered features designed to support learning in different ways. These may include things like course-specific AI chatbots, AI-generated notes and practice questions, multi-lingual translation of videos, intelligent video segmentation, video summarization, AI mock interviews and assessments etc.

There are three different AI feature sets available in the pilot program. Learners selected for the Pilot will be randomly assigned to one of these feature sets. Do note that each feature set contains a different combination of features, but all the feature sets aim to improve the learning experience in meaningful ways.

Click here to see a short overview of feature set 1

Click here to see a short overview of feature set 2

Want to participate?

If you're interested in being considered for the pilot, please fill out the short form below:

Click here to access the Google Form

As this is a pilot, there are a limited number of slots available in each course. Do note that participation is completely optional, and, as slots for the Pilot are limited, expressing interest does not guarantee a slot.

We’ll share more information with selected participants closer to the rollout. The pilot is expected to begin in the near future.

Thank you for your interest.

Best regards,
SWAYAM-NPTEL Team

body:
Dear Learners,


Thank you for enrolling in this NPTEL course and we hope you have gone through the contents for this week and also attempted the assignment.

We value your feedback and wish to know how you found the videos and the questions asked - whether they were easy, difficult, as per your expectations, etc

We shall use this to make the course better and we can also know from the feedback which concepts need more explanation, etc.


Please do spare some time to give your feedback - comprises just 5 questions - should not take more than a minute, but makes a lot of difference for us as we know what the Learners feel.

subject: Welcome to NPTEL Online Course : Introduction to Industry 4.0 and Industrial Internet of Things
body:
Dear Learner

Welcome to SWAYAM-NPTEL Online Courses and Certification!

Thank you for signing up for our online course "Introduction to Industry 4.0 and Industrial Internet of Things". We wish you an enjoyable and informative learning experience.

Details regarding the course:
Name of the course: Introduction to Industry 4.0 and Industrial Internet of Things 
Course url: https://onlinecourses.nptel.ac.in/noc25_cs146/preview
Course duration : 12 weeks 

The course will begin on 21 July 2025 When content is released on the portal, you will get an email alerting you.

CONTENT AND ASSIGNMENTS

Every week, about 2.5 to 4 hours of videos containing content by the Course instructor will be released along with an assignment based on this. Please watch the lectures, follow the course regularly and submit all assessments and assignments before the due date. Your regular participation is vital for learning and doing well in the course. This will be done week on week through the duration of the course.
Please do the assignments yourself and even if you take help, kindly try to learn from it. These assignment will help you prepare for the final exams. Plagiarism and violating the Honor code will be taken very seriously if detected during the submission of assignments.

ANNOUNCEMENT AND DISCUSSION GROUPS TO CLEAR DOUBTS:

The announcement group - will only have messages from course instructors and teaching assistants - regarding the lessons, assignments, exam registration, hall tickets etc.
The discussion forum (Ask a question tab on the portal) - is for everyone to ask questions and interact.Anyone who knows the answers can reply to anyone's post and the course instructor/TA will also respond to your queries. Please make maximum use of this feature as this will help you learn much better.
If you have any questions regarding the exam, registration, hall tickets, results, queries related to the technical content in the lectures, any doubts in the assignments, etc can be posted in the forum section

TO GET A CERTIFICATE - PROCESS AND CRITERIA:
The course is free to enroll and learn from. But if you want a certificate, you have to register and write the proctored exam conducted by us in person at any of the designated exam centres.
The exam is optional for a fee of Rs 1000/- (Rupees one thousand only).
Date and Time of Exams: 01 November 2025 Morning session 9am to 12 noon; Afternoon Session 2pm to 5pm.
Registration url: Announcements will be made when the registration form is open for registrations.
The online registration form has to be filled and the certification exam fee needs to be paid. More details will be made available when the exam registration form is published. If there are any changes, it will be mentioned then.
Please check the form for more details on the cities where the exams will be held, the conditions you agree to when you fill the form etc.

CRITERIA TO GET A CERTIFICATE

Average assignment score = 25% of average of best 8 assignments out of the total 12 assignments given in the course.
Exam score = 75% of the proctored certification exam score out of 100

Final score = Average assignment score + Exam score

YOU WILL BE ELIGIBLE FOR A CERTIFICATE ONLY IF AVERAGE ASSIGNMENT SCORE >=10/25 AND EXAM SCORE >= 30/75. If one of the 2 criteria is not met, you will not get the certificate even if the Final score >= 40/100.

Certificate will have your name, photograph and the score in the final exam with the breakup.It will have the logos of NPTEL and IIT Kharagpur. It will be e-verifiable at nptel.ac.in/noc.

Only the e-certificate will be made available. Hard copies will not be dispatched.

Once again, thanks for your interest in our online courses and certification. Happy learning.

- NPTEL team

subject: Reminder: NPTEL: Exam Registration is open now for July 2025 courses!
body:
Dear Learner, 


Here is the much-awaited announcement on registering for the July 2025 NPTEL course certification exam.


1. The registration for the certification exam is open only to those learners who have enrolled in the course. 

2. If you want to register for the exam for this course, login here using the same email id which you had used to enroll to the course in Swayam portal. Please note that Assignments submitted through the exam registered email id ALONE will be taken into consideration towards final consolidated score & certification. 

3. Date of exam: Nov 01, 2025 

CLICK HERE to register for the exam.

Choose from the Cities where exam will be conducted: Exam Cities


4. Exam fees: 


If you register for the exam and pay before Aug 11, 2025 - 5:00 PM, Exam fees will be Rs. 1000/- per exam.


5. 50% fee waiver for the following categories: 


Students belonging to the SC/ST category: please select Yes for the SC/ST option and upload the correct Community certificate.


Students belonging to the PwD category with more than 40% disability: please select Yes for the option and upload the relevant Disability certificate. 


6. Last date for exam registration: Aug 15, 2025 - 5:00 PM (Friday). 

7. Between Aug 11, 2025 - 5:00 PM & Aug 15, 2025 - 5:00 PM late fee will be applicable.


8. Mode of payment: Online payment - debit card/credit card/net banking/UPI. 


9. HALL TICKET: 


The hall ticket will be available for download tentatively by 2 weeks prior to the exam date. We will confirm the same through an announcement once it is published. 


10. FOR CANDIDATES WHO WOULD LIKE TO WRITE MORE THAN 1 COURSE EXAM:- you can add or delete courses and pay separately – till the date when the exam form closes. Same day of exam – you can write exams for 2 courses in the 2 sessions. Same exam center will be allocated for both the sessions. 


11. Data changes: 


Last date for data changes: Aug 15, 2025 - 5:00 PM: 

We will charge an additional fee of Rs. 200 to make any changes related to name, DOB, photo, signature, SC/ST and PWD certificates after the last date of data changes.


The following 6 fields can be changed (until the form closes) ONLY when there are NO courses in the course cart. And you will be able to edit those fields only if you: - 


REMOVE unpaid courses from the cart And/or - CANCEL paid courses 


1. Do you come under the SC/ST category? * 

2. SC/ST Proof 

3. Are you a person with disabilities? * 

4. Are you a person with disabilities above 40%? 

5. Disabilities Proof 

6. What is your role? 


Note: Once you remove or cancel a course, you will be able to edit these fields immediately. 

But, for canceled courses, refund of fees will be initiated only after 2 weeks. 


12. LAST DATE FOR CANCELING EXAMS and getting a refund: Aug 15, 2025 - 5:00 PM 


13. Click here to view Timeline and Guideline : Guideline


Domain Certification

Domain Certification helps learners to gain expertise in a specific Area/Domain. This can be helpful for learners who wish to work in a particular area as part of their job or research or for those appearing for some competitive exam or becoming job ready or specializing in an area of study.  

 

Every domain will comprise Core courses and Elective courses. Once a learner completes the requisite courses as per the mentioned criteria, you will receive a Domain Certificate showcasing your scores and the domain of expertise. Kindly refer to the following link for the list of courses available under each domain: https://nptel.ac.in/domains


Outside India Candidates

Candidates who are residing outside India may also fill the exam form and pay the fees. Mode of exam and other details will be communicated to you separately.


Thanks & Regards, 

NPTEL TEAM

subject: Welcome to NPTEL Online Course : Introduction to Internet of Things
body:
Dear Learner

Welcome to SWAYAM-NPTEL Online Courses and Certification!

Thank you for signing up for our online course "Introduction to Internet of Things". We wish you an enjoyable and informative learning experience.

Details regarding the course:
Name of the course: Introduction to Internet of Things 
Course url: https://onlinecourses.nptel.ac.in/noc25_cs147/preview
Course duration : 12 weeks 

The course will begin on 21 July 2025 When content is released on the portal, you will get an email alerting you.

CONTENT AND ASSIGNMENTS

Every week, about 2.5 to 4 hours of videos containing content by the Course instructor will be released along with an assignment based on this. Please watch the lectures, follow the course regularly and submit all assessments and assignments before the due date. Your regular participation is vital for learning and doing well in the course. This will be done week on week through the duration of the course.
Please do the assignments yourself and even if you take help, kindly try to learn from it. These assignment will help you prepare for the final exams. Plagiarism and violating the Honor code will be taken very seriously if detected during the submission of assignments.

ANNOUNCEMENT AND DISCUSSION GROUPS TO CLEAR DOUBTS:

The announcement group - will only have messages from course instructors and teaching assistants - regarding the lessons, assignments, exam registration, hall tickets etc.
The discussion forum (Ask a question tab on the portal) - is for everyone to ask questions and interact.Anyone who knows the answers can reply to anyone's post and the course instructor/TA will also respond to your queries. Please make maximum use of this feature as this will help you learn much better.
If you have any questions regarding the exam, registration, hall tickets, results, queries related to the technical content in the lectures, any doubts in the assignments, etc can be posted in the forum section

TO GET A CERTIFICATE - PROCESS AND CRITERIA:
The course is free to enroll and learn from. But if you want a certificate, you have to register and write the proctored exam conducted by us in person at any of the designated exam centres.
The exam is optional for a fee of Rs 1000/- (Rupees one thousand only).
Date and Time of Exams: 01 November 2025 Morning session 9am to 12 noon; Afternoon Session 2pm to 5pm.
Registration url: Announcements will be made when the registration form is open for registrations.
The online registration form has to be filled and the certification exam fee needs to be paid. More details will be made available when the exam registration form is published. If there are any changes, it will be mentioned then.
Please check the form for more details on the cities where the exams will be held, the conditions you agree to when you fill the form etc.

CRITERIA TO GET A CERTIFICATE

Average assignment score = 25% of average of best 8 assignments out of the total 12 assignments given in the course.
Exam score = 75% of the proctored certification exam score out of 100

Final score = Average assignment score + Exam score

YOU WILL BE ELIGIBLE FOR A CERTIFICATE ONLY IF AVERAGE ASSIGNMENT SCORE >=10/25 AND EXAM SCORE >= 30/75. If one of the 2 criteria is not met, you will not get the certificate even if the Final score >= 40/100.

Certificate will have your name, photograph and the score in the final exam with the breakup.It will have the logos of NPTEL and IIT Kharagpur. It will be e-verifiable at nptel.ac.in/noc.

Only the e-certificate will be made available. Hard copies will not be dispatched.

Once again, thanks for your interest in our online courses and certification. Happy learning.

- NPTEL team

subject: Fw: AICTE-MIC || Funding Support for 100 Patents and 20 Design Applications Per Institute - Reg.|| Phase I Deadline- 30th September 2025
body:
----- Forwarded Message ----- From: KAPILA Ministry of Educations Innovation Cell <kapila@aicte-india.org>Sent: Wednesday, July 16, 2025 at 05:34:05 PM GMT+5:30Subject: AICTE-MIC || Funding Support for 100 Patents and 20 Design Applications Per Institute - Reg.|| Phase I Deadline- 30th September 2025
 Dear Sir/ Madam,Greetings from the Ministry of Education’s Innovation Cell and AICTE !
“Avail funding for your IP through KAPILA”

This is to inform you that KAPILA 3.0 (Kalam Program for IP Literacy and Awareness) portal has been launched and is now live for use by Higher Education Institutions (HEIs), faculty members, researchers, and students. The redesigned portal, accessible at https://kapila.mic.gov.in, offers an improved user experience and streamlined features to facilitate seamless submission, tracking, and reimbursement of IP filing expenses.

In accordance with the updated provisions aimed at enhancing institutional participation and streamlining reimbursements under the IP support framework, we are pleased to convey the following details regarding financial assistance, eligibility timelines, and related guidelines.

Financial assistance under the revised scheme encompasses reimbursement of statutory fees for patent and design applications submitted to the Indian Patent Office.

Patent Applications:

| 
Fee Component
 | 
Particulars
 |
| 
Filing Fee (FORM-1)
 | 
₹1,600/-
 |
| 
Early Publication Fee (FORM-9)*
 | 
₹2,500/-
 |
| 
Examination Fee (FORM-18)
 | 
₹4,000/-
 |
| 
Expedited Examination Fee (FORM-18A)*
 | 
₹8,000/-
 |
| 
No. of Applications per Institution
 | 
100
 |


Design Applications:

| 
Fee Component
 | 
Particulars
 |
| 
Filing Fee (FORM-1)
 | 
₹1,000/-
 |
| 
No. of Application per Institution
 | 
20
 |


*Note: Early publication and expedited examination reimbursements are limited to the first 1,000 applications on a first-come, first-served basis.

Each institution may submit up to 100 patent applications for reimbursement in the financial year 2025–26. Eligible patent and design applications must be filed with the Indian Patent Office on or after January 1, 2024, and subsequently submitted on the KAPILA portal on or after March 1, 2025. Institutions that availed reimbursement of the filing fee in FY 2024–25 may also claim the examination fee reimbursement for the same applications, provided the submission is made by December 31, 2025.

In the case of design applications, institutions may claim reimbursement for a maximum of 20 applications, subject to a financial cap of ₹20,000. Applications currently under revision may also be submitted on the portal by December 31, 2025, subject to eligibility criteria.

All reimbursements under the scheme shall be made directly to the institution’s official bank account as grant-in-aid. These disbursals will be governed by the provisions of the General Financial Rules (GFR) and relevant guidelines issued by AICTE and the Government of India.

Kindly ensure compliance with the specified timelines and conditions to take full advantage of the financial support provided under the revised KAPILA scheme.

Webinar Information

An informational webinar followed by a Q&A session will be conducted on 17th July 2025 (Thursday) at 11:30 AM. To join the webinar, click on the provided link.

LINK: Meeting Title: KAPILA Orientation Session 2025-26

Dr. Elangovan Kariappan

This Is Dr.Inja Naga Bheema Lingeswar Reddy, Manager - IP and Technology
Transfer, Indovation center, Hyderabad (SCRO).

The All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) has recently
established Indovation centres to support innovations from
HEIs/Institutions and startups in the region.

We have planned a meetup to sensitize you regarding the Indovation centre,
significance and initiatives towards IP and technology transfer. We want to
understand the strengths and challenges of your organizations in supporting
innovations and IP and provide possible help to overcome those challenges.

We are currently scouting for innovations, ideas across Institutions which
have potential to be commercialized. I request you to please identify the
best technologies from each of your institutions and present it on that
day, please share the presentations with us via  google form too (It's not
mandatory to submit).


*Please nominate a person from your institute who can be a part of the
session - preferably working with IIC or startup Initiatives. You can bring
your startups/interested students too for the event. *

Response 06/23/2025 01:02 CST
Hi 

 

Thank you for reaching out to us. A temporary restriction was placed on your account because we detected suspicious activity. This restriction prevented all access to your account as we reviewed this issue.

 


we've now turned two-step verification off for your account so you can access it again without a pin code.

 

I am happy to share I have removed the restriction from your LinkedIn account and taken the following steps to secure it:

 

Your account has been signed out on all devices.

A password reset link has been sent to your primary email address.

Please access this link and update your password within the next 24 hours. If it's been more than 24 hours, let us know and we will send over a new one.

Once you successfully access your account, I suggest these steps to ensure your information is correct as it may have been modified during this incident:

 

Review your profile information and settings.

If your profile information has been changed or removed during this incident, you can now edit your profile to display the correct content. Please note that LinkedIn does not store previous profile information, so you'll need to update your profile if needed.

Check recent messages, invitations, display posts or comments for any unauthorized activity.

Lastly, I would recommend these best practices for your online privacy:

Check the email addresses on your account to ensure they are current:  https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/60 

Change the password on your email account(s) as soon as possible. If your email service provider offers two-step verification, we recommend that you enable it.

subject: Fwd: Invitation for Clear Skies Challenge (Last Date: June 30, 2025): A National Level Ideathon and Hackathon
body:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Operation Dronagiri <od@iittnif.com>
Date: Tue, Jun 17, 2025 at 5:28 PM
Subject: Invitation for Clear Skies Challenge (Last Date: June 30, 2025): A
National Level Ideathon and Hackathon
To: Abhilash Saini <techmgr.geo_intel@iittnif.com>


Dear Sir/Madam,

Greetings from IIT Tirupati Navavishkar I-Hub Foundation.

You would agree that air pollution is a significant national challenge, and
needs urgent attention. We are pleased to extend a cordial invitation to
the faculty members, research scholars, students, and startup community of
IIT Tirupati to participate in the *Clear Skies Challenge 2025*, a
national-level Ideathon and Hackathon aimed at developing innovative,
actionable solutions to address the pressing challenges of air pollution
and environmental monitoring.


This is a significant program under Operation Dronagiri, an initiative by
the Geospatial Innovation Council of the DST. As the Technology Innovation
Hub (TIH) at IIT Tirupati, We are privileged to lead this prestigious,
multi-stakeholder initiative in collaboration with Google (Industry
Partner), Air Pollution Action Group, A-PAG (Knowledge Partner), TiE
Delhi-NCR (Ecosystem Partner), and CDPG at IISc Bangalore (Data Partner).
with overall guidance from GDPDC and DST.


The Challenge is unfolded in two key phases- *Ideathon *where participants
have to present innovative ideas addressing critical challenges and
*Hackathon *where Selected teams will be mentored to develop working
prototypes of their proposed solutions. We would be deeply honoured by your
institution’s participation in this initiative. We respectfully request you
to *nominate deserving students/researchers/startups /faculties/employee *from
your institute to take part in this competition.

*Key Details:*

   -

   *Eligibility:* Undergraduate, Postgraduate, and Doctoral students from
   any discipline, Faculties & startups.
   -

   *Benefits:* National recognition, cash awards, certification,
   mentorship, access to Google AirView+ & GDI data, $500 Google Cloud credits
   for top 50 teams, and incubation opportunities.
   -

   *Website link:* *Click Here*
   <https://sites.google.com/iittnif.com/2025-hackathon-clear-skies/home>
   -

   *Brochure:* *Click Here*
   <https://drive.google.com/file/d/17yCRoMUEBbllbouYXqAtz_fOlKWWqi9W/view?usp=drive_link>
   -

   *Registration Link:* *Click Here* <https://forms.gle/aJL12HU9sJAs2RTu9>
   -

   *Last date to apply:* 30 June 2025


We look forward to your institution’s esteemed participation and to
welcoming your teams into this exciting innovation journey.


Regards,

Warm regards,

Abhilash Saini

Technology Manager

Geo-Intel Lab

IIT Tirupati Navavishkar I-Hub Foundation

+91-7988832727

Hi NIDDANA APURVA CSE,

 

We hope you're doing well and staying curious. We have some exciting news to share: New courses and cool tools that will make coding even more fun and educational.

New React JS Course

We’ve just launched a brand-new React JS course! Whether you’re a beginner or looking to refresh your skills, this course will guide you through building awesome web interfaces with React. You'll learn how to work with components, manage state and props, and use hooks to handle dynamic data. The best part? You can learn at your own pace, anytime and anywhere

  • Hands-on Projects: Build real web apps using React.

  • Step-by-Step Lessons: Follow clear tutorials on components, state, and more.

  • Self-Paced Learning: Go through material as quickly or slowly as you like.

Coming Soon: We’re also working on new backend-focused courses on Flask and Django — Stay Tuned!

Start the React JS course Now!
 

Code Visualizer Tool

Check out our  Code Visualizer in the Python, Java and C++ online compiler and courses. This awesome tool lets you run your code step-by-step and see exactly what happens. As your code executes, you’ll see English explanations pop up for each assignment and conditional statement .

 

This way, you really understand what your code is doing. If your code encounters an error, the Visualizer will pause just before it crashes and show you the state of all variables right before the error. It’s like having a debugger that talks to you!

Explore Code Visualizer Tool
 

AI Explain Feature

Debugging just got easier with our new AI Explain feature! Next time you see an error message in the CodeChef compiler, click the “Explain” link next to it. Our AI-powered helper will: 

  • Explain the Error: Tell you why the error happened in simple terms.

  • Show a Fix: Provide a corrected version of your code.

  • One-Click Solution: Let you copy the fix and run the corrected code instantly.

No more scratching your head over cryptic errors—this tool does the explaining and fixing for you.

Check out our AI Explain feature
 

Projects

We believe the best way to learn coding is by building real stuff — not just watching tutorials.

Whether you're preparing for internships, hackathons, or job interviews — these projects will help you apply your skills in real-world scenarios and stand out from the crowd.

 

🔰 For Beginners

  • Projects using HTML/CSS — Start with the basics of the web

  • Python Projects for Beginners — Write scripts and simple apps

  • C++ Projects for Beginners — Build logic-heavy mini tools

  • Java Projects for Beginners — Learn OOP the practical way

  • Projects for Beginners in C — Foundational coding made hands-on

⚙️ Intermediate Projects

  • Intermediate-level projects using Python — Take your skills to the next level

  • Intermediate-level projects using Java — From console to functional apps

Thanks for being part of the CodeChef community. We hope these new resources and tools help you learn faster and debug smarter.

 

Happy coding!

Team CodeChef

subject: KbSkupYfhW, Join Your First Contest and Win 200 LeetCoins!
body:
Join Your First Contest!

Saturday, March 1

 

﻿﻿Don't think you're ready for interviews yet? Contests are the best way to gauge how well-prepared you are and to simulate the environment of a real interview. By participating in contests, you will see weekly improvements in your progress and you will know how ready you are for the real deal.

We are hiring! Apply now for the opportunity to join LeetCode's content team as a problem adder or solution author. You can find more details and the application by seeing our announcement post and apply now!

﻿﻿After each contest, you can learn from the best by reading our official solutions and browsing the top-voted solutions in Discuss. As a special bonus, you will receive 200 LeetCoins for your first contest submission!

Weekly Contest 439 starts at 06:30 PM PST Saturday (10:30 AM Beijing Time Sunday), and Biweekly Contest 151 starts at 06:30 AM PST Saturday (10:30 PM Beijing Time Saturday). You will have 1.5 hours to solve a few interesting interview problems. If you participate in both contests, you will receive an additional bonus of 35 LeetCoins!

In addition to the bonus for first time participants, the Top 200 coders win prizes:

 

• 1st place wins 5000 LeetCoins.

• 2nd place wins 2500 LeetCoins.

• 3rd place wins 1000 LeetCoins.

• 4th - 50th place win 300 LeetCoins.

• 51st - 100th place win 100 LeetCoins.

• 101st - 200th place win 50 LeetCoins.

• Solve at least one problem to win 5 LeetCoins.

• Participate in both contests to win 35 LeetCoins.

See you on the scoreboard and good luck!

Join now!

Sincerely,
The LeetCode Team

Saturday, February 22

 

﻿﻿Don't think you're ready for interviews yet? Contests are the best way to gauge how well-prepared you are and to simulate the environment of a real interview. By participating in contests, you will see weekly improvements in your progress and you will know how ready you are for the real deal.

We are hiring! Apply now for the opportunity to join LeetCode's content team as a problem adder or solution author. You can find more details and the application by seeing our announcement post and apply now!

Our contest starts at 06:30 PM PST Saturday (10:30 AM Beijing Time Sunday). You will have 1.5 hours to solve a few interesting interview problems.

In addition to the bonus for first time participants, the Top 200 coders win prizes:

• 4th - 50th place win 300 LeetCoins.

• 51st - 100th place win 100 LeetCoins.

• 101st - 200th place win 50 LeetCoins.

See you on the scoreboard and good luck!

subject: LeetCode Weekly Digest
body:
Hi LeetCoder!
Behind every offer is a story of persistence, strategy, and growth! This LeetCoder’s journey to securing a Google SWE III (L4) offer in Bangalore is packed with insights and takeaways. Check out this post for a fresh dose of inspiration!

Don't forget to join us for the February LeetCoding Challenge. You can earn LeetCoins daily, and even get a chance to win some at the end of the month, as well as a LeetCode polo shirt. Happy LeetCoding! 😎
Top Picks For You
Question
3Sum
Given an integer array nums, return all the triplets [nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]] such that i != j, i != k,...
Post
Google | SWE-III (L4) | Bangalore | Dec 2024 [Offer]
1st Round: Elimination Round (Indian Interviewer) Problem 1: Given a 2D grid with obstacles, find a path from a source to a destination. Problem 2: A dynamic programming problem involving segment-based operations (similar to Codeforces 448C). Outcome: I fully implemented the first problem in 30 minutes using an optimal approach. For the second problem, I only managed a naive solution before time ran out. The interviewer seemed satisfied overall. ✅ Verdict: Positive 2nd Round: 1st Onsite (Indian Interviewer) Problem 1: Implement a pattern-matching system for IP addresses. Some patterns allow wildcards (e.g., 192.168.1.*), and the task was to check if a given query matched any pattern. Example input: [ "192.124.168.*", "192.124.64.*", "192.12.16.8", "192.124.6.1"] Query:"192.124.168.1" → Output: True Query:"192.124.16.8" → Output: False Follow-up: Extend the solution to handle multiple lists of patterns and process two IPs together. Outcome: I solved the first problem in 30 minutes and proposed multiple approaches. The interviewer liked my Trie-based solution and asked me to optimize it further. In the follow-up, I discussed modifications to the Trie for sequential lookups, which the interviewer appreciated. ✅ Verdict: Positive 3rd Round: 2nd Onsite (Indian Interviewer) Problem: A dependency problem where network routers must be hit in order of their dependencies. The question was hidden behind a lot of irrelevant context involving multiple POJOs Outcome: I quickly identified the problem’s core concept (topological sorting) and implemented a solution. While coding, I spotted a cycle detection edge case, which the interviewer appreciated. ✅ Verdict: Positive 4th Round: 3rd Onsite (Indian Interviewer) Problem: Given a text file and a list of banned words, replace all banned words with "REDACTED". Outcome: I initially suggested a simple iteration approach, but the interviewer raised scalability concerns. I then proposed reading the file in chunks for large-scale processing. Since I wasn’t familiar with file-handling methods at the time, I explained my logic with pseudo-code instead of a full implementation. Interviewer seemed unsatisfied, but the verdict remained positive. 5th Round: Googliness & Leadership (UK Interviewer) This was a behavioral round with 5 rapid-fire questions. I followed the STAR framework and focused on actions & results. The interviewer shared his own experiences, which reassured me that my responses resonated well. ✅ Verdict: Cleared Key Takeaways: Google allows a mock interview before the elimination round—I took one, and it helped me understand evaluation criteria. Fast typing helps in high-pressure situations—I practiced problem-solving under time constraints. LeetCode’s discussion section helped identify patterns in recent questions. Modular code and clear problem solving is given more importance. Glad to give back the community. Hope this helps you guys!

subject: KbSkupYfhW, Join Your First Contest and Win 200 LeetCoins!
body:
Join Your First Contest!

Saturday, February 8

 

﻿﻿Don't think you're ready for interviews yet? Contests are the best way to gauge how well-prepared you are and to simulate the environment of a real interview. By participating in contests, you will see weekly improvements in your progress and you will know how ready you are for the real deal.

We are hiring! Apply now for the opportunity to join LeetCode's content team as a problem adder or solution author. You can find more details and the application by seeing our announcement post and apply now!

﻿﻿After each contest, you can learn from the best by reading our official solutions and browsing the top-voted solutions in Discuss. As a special bonus, you will receive 200 LeetCoins for your first contest submission!

Our contest starts at 06:30 PM PST Saturday (10:30 AM Beijing Time Sunday). You will have 1.5 hours to solve a few interesting interview problems.

In addition to the bonus for first time participants, the Top 200 coders win prizes:

 

• 1st place wins 5000 LeetCoins.

• 2nd place wins 2500 LeetCoins.

• 3rd place wins 1000 LeetCoins.

• 4th - 50th place win 300 LeetCoins.

• 51st - 100th place win 100 LeetCoins.

• 101st - 200th place win 50 LeetCoins.

• Solve at least one problem to win 5 LeetCoins.

See you on the scoreboard and good luck!

Join now!

Sincerely,
The LeetCode Team

subject: Welcome to the CodeChef community
body:
Hey NIDDANA APURVA CSE,

I am really happy to know that you have joined CodeChef.

CodeChef is on a mission to help you learn and practice computer science in the most fun and engaging way.

A lot of students ask me for advice on how to use CodeChef or learn programming in general.

At CodeChef, we always had an opinionated view on this. We think that you learn best by applying what you have learned. Most students I see keep taking one course or another but can never actually retain the content after the course is over.

On CodeChef you will find less theory and a lot of practice, so that you never forget what you learn.

If you don't know programming start with any programming language course, because that is the first step. Then go on to learn logic building, data structures, algorithms, etc.


You can find all our courses here - https://www.codechef.com/learn


All of these courses are free to preview, but you have to buy Pro to complete the course and gain a certificate. We have put a lot of hard work in building these courses, and hope you will love them.


Regards,

Aniruddh

Product Head - CodeChef

subject: Tips for using your new inbox
body:
Tips for using your new inbox
[image: Gmail]

Welcome to your inbox
[image: Search]
Find emails fast
With the power of Google Search in your inbox, you can archive
<https://support.google.com/mail/answer/6576?hl=en&utm_source=gmailwelcomeemail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gmailwelcome>
all your email and find it
<https://support.google.com/mail/answer/6593?hl=en&utm_source=gmailwelcomeemail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gmailwelcome>
later in a flash. Your inbox stays tidy, and you never need to worry about
what to keep.
[image: Personalize]
Personalize LENDI INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY Mail
Customize inbox backgrounds, email signatures, and other options in LENDI
INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY Mail settings
<https://support.google.com/mail/answer/6562?hl=en&utm_source=gmailwelcomeemail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gmailwelcome>.
Review and adjust your privacy and security settings at My Account
<https://myaccount.google.com/>.
[image: Organize]
Organize your email
You can organize email with labels
<https://support.google.com/mail/answer/118708?hl=en&utm_source=gmailwelcomeemail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gmailwelcome>,
which are like folders, but you can add more than one label to a message.
You can also use filters
<https://support.google.com/mail/answer/6579?hl=en&utm_source=gmailwelcomeemail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gmailwelcome>
to automatically sort and categorize messages as they come in.
[image: Social]
Chat and meet directly from your inbox
Message with contacts in Google Chat
<https://support.google.com/chat/answer/9341104?hl=en&utm_source=gmailwelcomeemail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gmailwelcome>
and start video meetings with up to 100 people in Google Meet
<https://support.google.com/mail/answer/9822902?hl=en&utm_source=gmailwelcomeemail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gmailwelcome>
all without leaving Gmail.

Get training and tips
Find Gmail guides, tips, cheat sheets, help switching from Microsoft®
Outlook®, and more at the Google Workspace Learning Center
<https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9259748?hl=en&utm_source=gmailwelcomeemail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gmailwelcome>
.
Visit the Learning Center
<https://support.google.com/a/users/answer/9259748?hl=en&utm_source=gmailwelcomeemail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gmailwelcome>

Happy emailing,
